method: Multi-draft verification as optimal transport (OTM); K-SEQ approximation

speed: 2.13x vs AR, 1.37x vs SD (PaLM-2 Gecko->Bison, K=8, L=8, T=1; hardware not stated)

paper: Towards Optimal Multi-Draft SD (Hu et al.)
method: Computes optimal multi-draft acceptance via OT dual; proposes without-replacement and greedy drafting

method: Reduces multi-draft OT LP to max-flow / polymatroid convex problem with <=V variables
upside: makes the optimal multi-draft verifier tractable (10,000x+ faster than prior LP solvers)
method_downside: solver costs up to ~100 ms/token, far above a 20-50 ms decode step; optimal only for i.i.d. drafts; truncation set can be too large, forcing early termination (small deviation from target)
memory: not reported; convex solver state O(V) per token plus n<=10 draft KVs (est.)
quality: lossless in exact solve; truncated solve gives 'negligible deviation' from target
accepted_tokens: ~90% per-token acceptance (Llama-3 70B/8B, Gemma-2 27B/2B, n<=10, T=1); +1.03%/+0.47% acceptance vs other solvers at 100 ms budget
